response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, including geospatial data processing (GISCollective) and low-latency systems (Dunnhumby). However, his primary expertise lies in TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, and Dlang, with limited recent experience in C++ or Rust, which are critical for this role. His geospatial work is relevant but not directly tied to routing data pipelines or large-scale distributed systems.
strengths: Strong background in geospatial data processing and open-source GIS platforms (GISCollective)
Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies and languages (DLang, C++, Rust in personal projects)
concerns: Limited recent experience with C++ or Rust, which are primary technologies for this role
No direct experience with routing data pipelines or navigation systems in a professional capacity
Most recent professional work is in TypeScript/Node.js rather than systems programming
